result.title: LongSearchEval: Evaluating Long-Horizon Web Search Capabilities of Large Language Models via a Trajectory-Aware Agent Framework with Failure-Node Localization
result.summary: Long-horizon web search requires LLM-based agents to integrate information across web pages through extended interactions under task-specific constraints. Evaluating this capability is important not only for measuring final answer quality, but also for assessing whether an agent acquires, verifies, and uses evidence reliably over extended interactions. Existing evaluations, however, mainly rely on simulated trajectories or on post-hoc trajectories reconstructed from final answers, rather than on retained real interaction traces, which limits the fidelity of behavioral assessment and weakens support for fine-grained error localization. To address this gap, we introduce LONGSEARCHEVAL, a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework that combines a unified agent execution protocol with source constrained outcome verification and retrospective failure-node localization. Stage 1 verifies answer groups against agent-cited webpages without human-authored gold answers; Stage 2 audits normalized rounds and links flagged failure nodes to incorrect answer groups. We evaluate 16 models from eight families on 100 tasks, yielding 1,600 retained runs and 6,545 automatically flagged failure nodes. Trajectory collection and evaluation required 1,037 and 318 hours of cumulative runtime, respectively. Human validation yields 94.50% agreement on supplied answer-group labels and 98.11% feature-correspondence precision for audited round-group links. Together, outcome scores and linked trajectory evidence support controlled model comparison and retrospective inspection of answer-related content.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LONGSEARCHEVAL，一个面向长程网页搜索 agent 的轨迹感知评测框架：统一执行协议、基于 agent 所引用网页的来源约束结果验证，并在保留的真实交互轨迹上回溯定位失败节点，对 8 个家族 16 个模型、100 个任务共 1600 条轨迹做了评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「无金标答案的来源约束验证＋失败步骤定位」可能为核查 LVR 中答案是否真正依赖所引证据、以及轨迹贡献分配与错误归因提供借鉴；但任务为纯文本网页检索，与视觉或 latent 状态无直接关联，需较多核查。
